【今日摘要】
今天市場情緒強勁，道瓊工業平均指數創下新高。科技股領導市場上漲，包括Nvidia、Palantir和V2X等公司。人工智慧領域的發展也成為市場關注的焦點，包括埃隆·馬斯克的機器人和中國的DeepSeek AI等。投資者們對於未來市場趨勢感到樂觀，但也需要注意風險和挑戰。

【結語】
投資者們應該保持謹慎和耐心，避免被市場情緒所左右。需要注意的是，市場的波動和風險，包括人工智慧領域的發展和中國的政策變動等。投資者們應該根據自己的投資目標和風險承受能力進行投資決策，並保持長期的觀點。

items.summary: Nvidia will likely still lead AI in five years, but its business may change from the chip giant investors know today.

items.title: Review & Preview: Starting Strong
items.summary: REVIEW PREVIEW NEWSLETTER Fresh Record. Markets kicked off the first trading day of August on a strong note, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average closing at a new high on Monday. The pullback in oil prices held despite Iran’s denial of any peace talks taking place, allowing markets to look through the latest geopolitical back-and-forth and focus on a Magnificent 7 rally.

items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wants to defend the yen without selling Treasurys into a sensitive U.S. bond market. The Federal Reserve could help.
items.zh_title: 聯邦儲備局可能被拉入支持日圓的努力
items.zh_point: 美國財政部長史考特·貝森特（Scott Bessent）希望為日圓提供支持，但不願出售美國國債進入敏感的美國債券市場。聯邦儲備局可能會提供幫助。

items.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: AI wins come with an old investor risk
items.summary: From a surprise yuan devaluation in 2015 to crackdowns in recent years, many of Beijing's policy moves appear abrupt to outsiders.

items.zh_point: CNBC的中國連線通訊指出，人工智慧的勝利來之不易，但投資者仍面臨著北京政策突然變動的風險，從2015年的幣值突然下跌到近年來的打壓，北京的政策變動讓外界感到措手不及。

items.title: Big Tech's Anthropic and OpenAI stakes are distorting the corporate earnings picture
